alignment.name: alignments
alignment.description: Sequencing reads mapped to positions in a reference genome, typically in BAM/CRAM format with mapping quality scores and alignment coordinates.

edamMapping.comment: Direct match: aligned reads to reference

alignment.name: alignments with modifications
alignment.description: Aligned reads preserving base modification information (e.g., methylation from bisulfite-seq or direct detection) encoded in BAM auxiliary fields.

alignment.name: diploid personal genome alignments
alignment.description: Reads aligned to a diploid personal genome reference including both parental haplotypes, enabling allele-specific analysis.

alignment.name: gene alignments
alignment.description: Reads or sequences aligned at the gene level.

alignment.name: preprocessed alignments
alignment.description: Alignments after preprocessing: duplicate marking, base quality score recalibration, or indel realignment.

alignment.name: reads
alignment.description: Raw or minimally processed sequencing reads in FASTQ format, including quality scores and read identifiers.

alignment.name: redacted alignments
alignment.description: Alignments with sensitive genomic positions masked or removed for privacy protection in controlled-access data sharing.

alignment.name: redacted transcriptome alignments
alignment.description: Transcriptome-level alignments with sensitive positions redacted.

alignment.name: rejected reads
alignment.description: Reads that failed quality control filters and were excluded from downstream analysis.

alignment.name: spike-in alignments
alignment.description: Reads aligned to exogenous spike-in control sequences (e.g., ERCC) for normalization and quality assessment.

alignment.name: transcriptome alignments
alignment.description: Reads aligned to a transcriptome reference (cDNA sequences) rather than the genome.

signal_track.name: base overlap signal
signal_track.description: Signal computed from base-level read overlap counts at each genomic position.

signal_track.name: bias-corrected predicted signal profile
signal_track.description: Model-predicted signal after correction for sequence-composition bias.

signal_track.name: control normalized signal
signal_track.description: Signal normalized against a matched control experiment to remove background and technical artifacts.

signal_track.name: enrichment
signal_track.description: Quantitative enrichment score over background, measuring signal above expected noise level.

signal_track.name: fold change over control
signal_track.description: Signal expressed as the ratio of experimental signal to input/control, highlighting enrichment over background.

signal_track.name: signal
signal_track.description: Quantitative signal track showing per-base or per-bin values across the genome, typically in bigWig format.

signal_track.name: signal p-value
signal_track.description: Statistical significance track showing -log10(p-value) of enrichment at each position.

edamMapping.comment: Partial: no signal-specific p-value in EDAM

signal_track.name: summed densities signal
signal_track.description: Signal computed as the sum of per-base read densities across the region.

signal_track.name: wavelet-smoothed signal
signal_track.description: Signal smoothed using wavelet transform to reduce noise while preserving peak structure.

signal_track.name: bias profile
signal_track.description: Sequencing bias profile across genomic positions.

peak_set.name: bidirectional peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks from bidirectional transcription signal, characteristic of active enhancers and promoters.

peak_set.name: conservative IDR thresholded peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks using a conservative (stricter) IDR cutoff, yielding high-confidence but smaller peak set.

peak_set.name: distal peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks located distal (>2-3kb) from transcription start sites, often representing enhancers.

peak_set.name: divergent peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks from divergent transcription where initiation occurs in both directions from a central point.

peak_set.name: IDR ranked peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks ranked by IDR score, with lower IDR indicating higher reproducibility across replicates.

peak_set.name: optimal IDR thresholded peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks using the optimal IDR cutoff balancing sensitivity and reproducibility.

peak_set.name: peaks
peak_set.description: Discrete genomic regions of statistically significant enrichment from peak calling. The fundamental unit of ChIP-seq and ATAC-seq analysis.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM lacks specific peak data type

soMapping.comment: Re-graded from relatedMatch: peak rows ARE experimental result regions; the earlier objection was that SO:0001697 ChIP_seq_region is assay-bound, a different point

peak_set.name: peaks and background as input for IDR
peak_set.description: Combined peak and background signal data formatted as input for IDR analysis.

peak_set.name: proximal peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks located proximal (<2-3kb) to transcription start sites, often representing promoters.

peak_set.name: pseudoreplicated IDR thresholded peaks
peak_set.description: IDR-thresholded peaks from pseudoreplicates (subsampled reads) when true replicates unavailable.

peak_set.name: pseudoreplicated peaks
peak_set.description: Peak calls from pseudoreplicates created by subsampling reads from a single experiment.

peak_set.name: replicated peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks reproducibly called across biological or technical replicates.

peak_set.name: representative DNase hypersensitivity sites
peak_set.description: A curated representative set of DNase hypersensitivity sites for reference.

peak_set.name: representative IDR thresholded peaks
peak_set.description: A representative set of IDR-thresholded peaks selected for downstream analysis.

peak_set.name: unidirectional peaks
peak_set.description: Peaks from unidirectional transcription signal, typically associated with gene bodies.

peak_set.name: valleys
peak_set.description: Local minima in signal tracks used in footprint detection or nucleosome positioning analysis.

chromatin_accessibility.name: consensus DNase hypersensitivity sites
chromatin_accessibility.description: DNase I hypersensitivity sites consistently identified across multiple samples or cell types.

chromatin_accessibility.name: DHS peaks
chromatin_accessibility.description: Peak calls from DNase I hypersensitivity sequencing (DNase-seq), indicating open chromatin regions.

chromatin_accessibility.name: DHS regions reference
chromatin_accessibility.description: Reference set of DNase I hypersensitivity regions.

chromatin_accessibility.name: FDR cut rate
chromatin_accessibility.description: False discovery rate-controlled cut rate signal from DNase-seq analysis.

chromatin_accessibility.name: hotspots
chromatin_accessibility.description: Broad regions of elevated DNase cleavage activity representing domains of chromatin accessibility.

chromatin_accessibility.name: hotspots1 reference
chromatin_accessibility.description: Reference hotspot calls at lenient threshold (hotspot1 algorithm).

chromatin_accessibility.name: hotspots2 reference
chromatin_accessibility.description: Reference hotspot calls at stringent threshold (hotspot2 algorithm).

chromatin_accessibility.name: nuclease cleavage frequency
chromatin_accessibility.description: Per-base frequency of DNase I or Tn5 transposase cleavage across the genome.

soMapping.comment: Group C: rows are per-base numbers, not nuclease-sensitive sites; fails the DataType admissibility rule

contact_matrix.name: contact matrix
contact_matrix.description: Genome-wide matrix of chromatin interaction frequencies from Hi-C or similar chromosome conformation capture experiments.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM has topic; lacks contact matrix data type

contact_matrix.name: pairs
contact_matrix.description: Raw read pair data from Hi-C or proximity ligation before matrix construction.

regulatory_element.name: enhancer prediction model
regulatory_element.description: Model predicting enhancer activity from sequence or chromatin features.

regulatory_element.name: regulatory elements prediction model
regulatory_element.description: Computational model for predicting regulatory element activity and location.

crispr_screen.name: element barcode mapping
crispr_screen.description: Mapping of element barcodes used in CRISPR screen experiments.

crispr_screen.name: gRNAs
crispr_screen.description: Guide RNA sequences used in CRISPR screens.

soMapping.comment: CRISPR single-guide RNA (SO:0000602 guide_RNA is the RNA-editing sense)

crispr_screen.name: guide locations
crispr_screen.description: Genomic locations targeted by guide RNAs.

crispr_screen.name: guide quantifications
crispr_screen.description: Abundance quantifications of guide RNAs from screen data.

crispr_screen.name: non-targeting gRNAs
crispr_screen.description: Guide RNAs designed as non-targeting negative controls.

soMapping.comment: Control guides; targeting status is not an SO axis

crispr_screen.name: perturbation signal
crispr_screen.description: Phenotypic signal associated with CRISPR perturbations.

crispr_screen.name: ranked gRNAs
crispr_screen.description: Guide RNAs ranked by screen performance or activity.

crispr_screen.name: reporter code counts
crispr_screen.description: Count data from reporter codes in CRISPR screen readouts.

crispr_screen.name: safe-targeting gRNAs
crispr_screen.description: Guide RNAs targeting genomic safe-harbor loci as controls.

crispr_screen.name: sparse gRNA count matrix
crispr_screen.description: Sparse count matrix of guide RNA abundances across cells.

count_matrix.name: fold over change matrix
count_matrix.description: Matrix of fold-change values relative to control across features.

count_matrix.name: sparse gene count matrix
count_matrix.description: Sparse matrix of gene-level read counts across cells or samples, standard for single-cell RNA-seq.

count_matrix.name: sparse peak count matrix
count_matrix.description: Sparse matrix of peak accessibility counts across cells, used in single-cell ATAC-seq.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM lacks peak count matrix type

count_matrix.name: sparse transcript count matrix
count_matrix.description: Sparse matrix of transcript-level counts across cells or samples.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM lacks transcript count matrix type

count_matrix.name: TF peaks matrix
count_matrix.description: Matrix of transcription factor peak counts across samples.

count_matrix.name: z scores matrix
count_matrix.description: Matrix of z-score normalized values across features and samples.

count_matrix.name: sparse splice junction count matrix
count_matrix.description: Sparse count matrix of splice junctions.

count_matrix.name: signals matrix
count_matrix.description: Matrix of signal values across features and samples.

quantification.name: differential expression quantifications
quantification.description: Statistical results from differential expression analysis comparing conditions.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM lacks differential expression data type

quantification.name: differential splicing quantifications
quantification.description: Statistical results from differential splicing analysis comparing conditions.

edamMapping.comment: EDAM lacks differential splicing data type

quantification.name: element quantifications
quantification.description: Quantification values for regulatory elements.

quantification.name: exon quantifications
quantification.description: Read counts or expression values quantified at individual exons.

quantification.name: gene quantifications
quantification.description: Expression quantifications at gene level as read counts, TPM, or FPKM values.

quantification.name: gene stabilities
quantification.description: Measurements of mRNA or gene expression stability over time.

quantification.name: genic features quantifications
quantification.description: Quantifications across various genic features (exons, introns, UTRs).

quantification.name: genic regions quantifications
quantification.description: Read count quantifications over defined genic regions.

quantification.name: merged transcription segment quantifications
quantification.description: Quantifications from merged transcription segments.

quantification.name: microRNA quantifications
quantification.description: Expression quantifications of microRNAs (miRNAs).

quantification.name: mRNA stabilities
quantification.description: Measurements of mRNA half-life or decay rates.

quantification.name: novel peptides
quantification.description: Peptides identified that are absent from reference databases.

quantification.name: peptide quantifications
quantification.description: Abundance measurements of peptides from mass spectrometry proteomics.

quantification.name: protein expression quantifications
quantification.description: Abundance measurements of proteins from proteomics data.

quantification.name: scaled RNA stability
quantification.description: RNA stability measurements scaled across samples.

quantification.name: transcript quantifications
quantification.description: Expression quantifications at transcript isoform level.

quantification.name: transcribed region quantifications
quantification.description: Quantifications over transcribed genomic regions.

quantification.name: transcription segment quantifications
quantification.description: Quantifications over discrete transcription segments.

quantification.name: UV enriched segment quantifications
quantification.description: Quantifications from UV-crosslinking enriched RNA segments.

quantification.name: modified peptide quantification
quantification.description: Quantification of post-translationally modified peptides.

deep_learning.name: counts sequence contribution scores

deep_learning.name: DNN-MPRA predicted signal

deep_learning.name: model performance metrics

deep_learning.description: Trained computational or machine learning models saved for prediction or interpretation.

deep_learning.name: motif model

deep_learning.description: Per-nucleotide importance scores explaining sequence contribution to predicted signal profiles.

deep_learning.name: promoter prediction model

deep_learning.name: selected regions for bias-corrected predicted signal profile
deep_learning.description: Genomic regions selected for bias-corrected signal profile interpretation.

deep_learning.name: selected regions for count sequence contribution scores
deep_learning.description: Genomic regions selected for count contribution score analysis.

deep_learning.name: selected regions for predicted bias profile

deep_learning.description: Genomic regions selected for combined signal and contribution score analysis.

deep_learning.description: Genomic regions selected for predicted signal profile interpretation.

deep_learning.name: selected regions for profile sequence contribution scores
deep_learning.description: Genomic regions selected for profile contribution score analysis.

deep_learning.description: Deep learning model predicting transcription factor binding from DNA sequence.

deep_learning.description: Genomic regions designated for model training and held-out evaluation.

deep_learning.name: training set
deep_learning.description: Data used to train a computational or machine learning model.

variant.description: Computational predictions of variant functional impact.
